name: Finncon
blurb: Finland's largest science-fiction and fantasy event: a free, all-ages convention with literature, panels and guests that rotates between Finnish cities.
notes: Finncon did not run in 2025 ('Miksi ei Finnconia 2025?' is a headline on its own news list). The homepage only promises 'kiinnostavia vieraita' (interesting guests) in generic marketing copy, with no named guests or a guest-listing subpage found, so guests is 'none-yet'. No specific venue hall within Espoo was named on the homepage.
